framework.name: Product Manager
framework.description: Competency framework for Product Managers across Junior, Middle, and Senior levels, covering research, lifecycle/economics, delivery, marketing, leadership, people management, and influence.

scale.name: Proficiency 0-10
scale.description: Each subsequent proficiency level builds upon the previous one.

points.label: Surface-level exposure (I have heard/read/studied it briefly).
Basic application (I'm familiar with theory and have brief practical exposure; <1 year experience).
Core competence (I'm fluent in foundational theory, experienced in specific methodology; ≥1.5 year experience).
Advanced mastery (I have deep structural knowledge of theory and nuances, proven track record; ≥2 years experience).
Strategic capability & Guidance (I have strategic application, contextual judgment, and ability to guide others; ≥3 years experience).
Subject Matter Expert & Mentor (I have in-depth mentoring, training, and systemic education of others; ≥5 years experience).

levels.name: Junior
levels.description: Level 3 Product Manager: Core Product Support & Optimization. Continues to master the profession. Handles standard scenarios independently, but seeks guidance in complex situations. Deliverables may require peer review.

levels.name: Middle
levels.description: Level 2 Product Manager: End-to-End Product Management & P&L. Fully autonomous; independently navigates any situation.

levels.name: Senior
levels.description: Level 1 Product Manager: Multi-Product Portfolio Management & Cross-Product P&L. Possesses deep domain expertise, enabling custom solutions and performance that exceeds standards. Proposes and implements changes that drive impact in their scope. Preserves and scales knowledge within the company, mentoring others and elevating team capabilities.

I maintain a registry of prospective client queries.
I analyze feedback from prospective clients.

Middle.name: Driving Growth and Alignment through Feedback and Purpose

actions.statement: I provide timely and constructive feedback.
I ensure team members understand the purpose of their tasks, the expected outcomes, and how their work impacts the team's overall goals.

Senior.name: Building Personal Connections and Psychological Safety

actions.statement: I genuinely care about each team member, taking an active interest in both their professional progress and personal well-being, and
I am always ready to listen and support them through personal challenges.
I foster an environment where it is safe to make mistakes, and ensure every team member knows they have the room to fail and learn.
I maintain transparency by providing equal access to information for all team members including company goals, upcoming changes, and active projects.
I hold regular touchpoints with every team member, including 1-on-1s, Individual Development Plan (IDP) reviews, and project syncs.
I maintain a welcoming attitude and am always approachable.
I practice active listening to genuinely understand my counterpart.
I proactively give and request feedback regarding team interaction and workflows.
I convey information clearly, concisely, and structurally (verbally, in writing, and visually).
I communicate and defend the product vision using concrete, data-driven arguments.
I collaborate effectively with adjacent departments, sharing and adopting best practices.
I inspire and mobilize people around me to collaborate toward shared goals.
I build long-term professional relationships with colleagues and partners.
I take extreme ownership of decisions and assume responsibility for team outcomes, even in failure.
I vocalize and defend my viewpoint with strong rationale, even when it challenges the majority.
I maintain a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset in any situation.
I dynamically adapt my communication style depending on the stakeholder/interlocutor.
I drive effective, frictionless collaboration within my department and across business units.
